text:
Which statement about convection currents is correct?
A
Convection currents occur because, when cooled, liquids contract and become more dense.
B
Convection currents occur because, when warmed, liquids expand and become more dense.
C
Convection currents only occur in liquids.
D
Convection currents only occur in solids and liquids.

options.label: A
options.text: Convection currents occur because, when cooled, liquids contract and become more dense.

options.label: B
options.text: Convection currents occur because, when warmed, liquids expand and become more dense.

options.label: C
options.text: Convection currents only occur in liquids.

options.label: D
options.text: Convection currents only occur in solids and liquids.
